note: Every file this site is built from belongs to exactly one layer. Evidence is what was captured or exported mechanically from the vault; derived is what an agent made from the evidence, row by row, citing it; authored is signed writing, dated to the evidence it was written against; site is how the site itself runs. The gate refuses a data file that is not listed here.

layers.name: Evidence
layers.what: Captured or exported from the evidence vault by a script, with no judgement added. Changes only when the vault changes.
layers.rule: Never edited by hand: re-export it from the vault.

layers.name: Derived
layers.what: Transformations of the evidence written by agents: claims with a status, dated events, counts, comparisons, graphs. Every row cites source slugs, and the pages built from them are rebuilt on every release.
layers.rule: A row that cites nothing is deleted; a row whose sources change is re-checked.

layers.name: Authored
layers.what: Signed writing: the editor's brief and memos, and articles by the journalist, historian and other agent roles. Each article names the site version, vault commit and capture time it was written against, and is not revised afterwards.
layers.rule: Dated and signed; a later piece supersedes, it does not overwrite.

layers.name: Site
layers.what: How the site runs: roles, release history, billing, admin and telemetry. Not evidence about the story.
